description: CALL Format 2 (program-prototype) - the AS phrase, ISO §2023:14.9.4.2 Format 2 (AS NESTED / AS program-prototype-name-1), a COBOL-2002 introduction with program prototypes and the NESTED reserved word. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 CALL statement names the called program by literal-1 or identifier-1 alone (§1985:X.5.2.2, whose formats print `CALL {identifier-1 | literal-1} [USING ... BY CONTENT { identifier-2 } ...]` then ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 or [NOT] ON EXCEPTION and END-CALL; §1985:X.5.2.4 GR1: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the name of the called program"), and §2002:F.1 item 6 ("The following reserved words have been added") lists AS, NESTED and PROTOTYPE; the 2002 CALL adds Format 3 (program-prototype), `CALL [ {identifier-1 | literal-1} ] AS {NESTED | program-prototype-name-1}`, with §2002:14.8.4.2 SR12 "The NESTED phrase may be specified only in a program definition" and SR14 "Program-prototype-name-1 shall be specified in a program-specifier in the REPOSITORY paragraph", and §2002:F.2 item 106 states the prototypes ("This permits passing parameters by value, omission of parameters, type checking and coercion of arguments"). §2014:14.9.4.2 SR13 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR13 carry the 2002 rule (the format renumbered Format 2 in 2023; §2023:14.9.4.4 GR7: "If the NESTED phrase is not specified, program-prototype-name-1 is used to determine the characteristics of the called program"). The FMT-14.9.4.2 row's residue 'the AS-phrase edition gate' re-measured by kb/Work PB239: an 85 compile ACCEPTED `CALL "X" AS NESTED` with no diagnostic. Recognition gate on callAsPhrase. The bare program-prototype-name spelling of Format 2 is the program-prototype-name-2002 row: it needs no REPOSITORY paragraph when the name is the element's own or a containing program definition's (§2023:8.4.6.8), so the REPOSITORY entry's gate cannot stand for it (kb/Work PB4509).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CASX1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X PIC X(6) VALUE "ABCDEF".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CALL "CASX2" AS NESTED USING X.
    STOP RUN.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CASX2.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L PIC X(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L.
P.
    EXIT PROGRAM.
END PROGRAM CASX2.
END PROGRAM CASX1.
